name: agentlane
description: Map an agentic repository into an interactive Agentlane Diagram with source-backed prompt/code inspection and optional multi-agent simulation.

interface.shortDescription: Map workflows and inspect prompts, code, and simulated node outputs.
interface.longDescription: Create a standalone HTML swimlane map from the current repository. Inspect actual source-backed prompts and code, then optionally use native coding-agent subagents to simulate the workflow without application API calls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agentlane to map this repository into an interactive Agentlane Diagram and offer an optional simulation.
